paper_title: Exotic energy injection in the early universe II: CMB spectral distortions and constraints on light dark matter
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, converted from the paper's DM->gamma gamma lifetime limits tau via g = sqrt(64*pi/(tau*m^3))
notes: Paper extends CMB anisotropy (Planck 2015-based) constraints on DM->gamma gamma decay down to m_chi = 2R ~ 27.2 eV and recasts them as ALP-photon coupling limits (Fig. 10, masses ~10 eV to 1 MeV). No numerical table for g_agamma is given; data points were derived by converting lifetime limits stated in the text/figure legends (tau >~ 1e25 s at m=2R; tau = 7.0e24 s at 10 keV, 3.6e24 s at 85 keV, 2.7e24 s at 720 keV from Fig. 2/9) using the standard ALP decay rate Gamma = g^2 m^3 / (64 pi). Intermediate-mass points (100 eV, 1 keV) assume tau ~ 1e25 s per the extended constraint plateau in Fig. 9, so they are approximate. Cosmological bound: no local DM density assumption applies. Confidence level assumed 95% (standard for Planck-based decay constraints; not explicitly stated in provided text). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.55, 6))
